svg.title: The silent version failure is the dangerous one
svg.desc: One fitted pipeline object drawn as nested boxes crosses a dashed version wall from scikit-learn 1.9.0 to 1.5.2 by three arrows: logistic regression ends in a loud AttributeError, random forest loads with a zero prediction difference, and HistGradientBoosting loads silently wrong with a prediction difference of 1.525e-01 circled in red; below, a latency bar splits 5.127 milliseconds into preprocessing and model time against a batched 0.0103 milliseconds per row, and a PSI ruler places three drift measurements against the 0.10 and 0.25 thresholds.
svg.text: The silent version failure is the dangerous one
LOUD. This is the GOOD failure.
IT LOADED. IT RAN. IT IS WRONG. Only a warning.
production is worse than a crash. A crash
pin the version, hash the artifact
WHERE THE MILLISECONDS GO - one row
5.127 ms per row, one row at a time
a pickle is a promise that two environments are
identical. Store the library versions beside the
artifact, and refuse to serve on a mismatch.
...and the model is only 5% of the system -> Sculley 2015
